useCase: Detección de texto generado por IAure and style patrones through neural característica correlación análisis
mechanism: It drags the canvas kicking and screaming through the deepest Convolutional Feature Maps. There, deliberately annihilating 'Where' an object exists (spatial position is vaporized entirely), it violently forces structural feature layers to cross-multiply. This anatomically strips the fundamental rules of the texture (grit, smoothness, gloss). Organic photography harbors infinite, chaotic structural variety resulting in a pristine Gram symmetry. Fraudulent AI constructs hallucinate textures mathematically, violently shattering the Gram spinal cord into hundreds of jagged, alienated quadrants. Splice artists stitching alien faces onto organic skin will cause the Gram matrix to screech with dissonant clashing frequencies.
name: Análisis de Textura de Matriz Gram
source: Gatys et al. (2016) - Image Style Transfer Using CNNs, CVPR; adapted for forensics
algorithm: VGG-19 Feature Extraction + Gram Matrix Comparison
parameters: Backbone: VGG-19, Layers: conv1_1 through conv5_1, Gram matrix: F^T × F normalized, Comparison: Frobenius norm distance
description: Computes Gram matrix from CNN característica maps to capture style and texture correlacións. AI images produce distinctive Gram matrix patrones different from natural photographs.

references.title: Gatys, L.A. et al. (2016). Image Style Transfer Using Convolutional Neural Networks. CVPR.
Liu, Z. et al. (2020). Global Texture Enhancement for Fake Face Detection in the Wild. CVPR.

strengths:
• Captures deep texture correlacións
• Effective a través de different AI architectures
• Multi-scale análisis through multiple layers
• Well-established theoretical foundation
limitations:
• Computacionalmente costoso (requires CNN forward pass)
• Sensitive to image resolución changes
• Style transfer images may create falsos positivos
• Requires pre-trained model weights
